## 📚 Documentation Issue

### 📖 Documentation Type
- [ ] **User Guide** - End-user documentation
- [ ] **API Reference** - Technical API documentation
- [ ] **Developer Guide** - Contributing/development docs
- [ ] **Tutorial** - Step-by-step guides
- [ ] **README** - Project overview documentation
- [ ] **Installation Guide** - Setup instructions
- [ ] **Troubleshooting** - Problem-solving guides
- [ ] **Architecture** - System design documentation

### 🔧 Issue Type
- [ ] **Missing Documentation** - Feature/function not documented
- [ ] **Outdated Information** - Documentation doesn't match current version
- [ ] **Incorrect Information** - Documentation contains errors
- [ ] **Unclear Instructions** - Confusing or ambiguous content
- [ ] **Broken Links** - Links don't work or go to wrong places
- [ ] **Formatting Issues** - Markdown, styling, or display problems
- [ ] **Translation Issues** - Language or localization problems
- [ ] **Accessibility Issues** - Documentation not accessible
